pairs.why: A's teal hull is a soft, satin painted plastic like the real toy-like objects, while B's hull is a bright, glossy silver chrome that reads as metal with hard highlights.
A's locker is chunky, smooth, soft-sheen enamel like the real one, while B's thinner, sharper panels with tiny rivets and a shiny floor go crisper than the real cards.
Both pumps have the same smooth satin enamel and similar cracked stone bases, and neither is clearly nearer the real one's soft matte paint with chipped patches.
Both clocks have the same glossy orange rim with a bright highlight, which is a little shinier than the real rim, so my vector gives no reason to choose.
B's gloves have soft, satin red leather with gentle highlights like the real ones, while A has sharper shiny glints and scratchy marks.
A is clean, clear glass with crisp window highlights and a smooth gold stand, similar to the real glass and camera, while B's internal painted swirl and glow add smeary, painterly marks.
A's large spotlight body has a smooth satin dark-blue finish with soft highlights like the real one, while B's hero is small and its surface detail is lost.
A's fabric and soft grey satin tubes sit closer to the real chair's smooth cloth and matte tubes, while B's thin shiny chrome tubes are glossier and more metallic.
